title: Historic Multi-Story Building Entrance, 1930s B&W Architectural Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot showing the exterior entrance of a multi-story building, characteristic of Spanish Colonial Revival or early modern civic/hotel architecture. An angled-rod canopy projects over the central entryway, accompanied by a decorative lamppost at the steps and delicate wrought-iron railings along the upper balconies, set before an expansive paved driveway or courtyard.
